# Kernel patches

The patches in this directory are modifications to the Linux kernel and are
licensed under GPL-2.0-only, matching the target kernel tree. They apply to the
exact OpenIPC Linux commit recorded in [THIRD_PARTY.md](../../THIRD_PARTY.md).

`0001-hi3536dv100-k75-boot-fixes.patch` contains the changes needed for the
tested K75 board and the supported modern build host.
